text:
It has traded for many years.

Harbury Traders quotes 125 per unit, delivers in 13 days, and holds a rating of 9 out of 10. It prefers orders by post.

Varbury Works quotes 90 per unit, delivers in 18 days, and holds a rating of 6 out of 10. Its office closes early on market days.

Istnick Outfitters quotes 140 per unit, delivers in 16 days, and holds a rating of 8 out of 10. Its office closes early on market days.

Which supplier quotes at most 120 per unit, delivers within 11 days and is rated at least 8 out of 10?
